'''Grand Admiral Pitta's torpedo sphere''' was a nineteen-hundred-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] [[Torpedo Sphere/Legends|vessel]] that [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Danetta Pitta]] took [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of when he became a [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] independent from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY's]] [[Battle of Tralus (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Tralus]], Pitta used the [[Proton torpedo/Legends|torpedo]] sphere to decimate the [[Warship/Legends|warship]] [[Fleet/Legends|armada]] of rival Grand Admiral [[Josef Grunger]], but the latter then rammed his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Aggressor (Executor-class)|''Aggressor'']], into Pitta's [[Starship/Legends|craft]], [[Death/Legends|killing]] both of them.

==Description==
Grand Admiral Pitta's torpedo sphere<ref name="CSWE Tralus">{{CSWECite|III|259|Tralus}}</ref> was a massive [[Torpedo Sphere/Legends|torpedo sphere]]<ref name="Insider66" /> that was manufactured by [[Loronar Defense Industries]]<ref name="EGtD" /> and measured 1,900 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in diameter.<ref name="CSWE torpedo" />

==History==
[[File:GAPitta-SWI66.png|thumb|right|300px|Grand Admiral Danetta Pitta perished while in command of the torpedo sphere.]]
When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] began fragmenting in the aftermath of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Imperial [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Danetta Pitta]]<ref name="Insider66" /> became a self-proclaimed [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]]<ref name="CSWE Pitta">{{CSWECite|III|27|Pitta, Grand Admiral Danetta}}</ref> and used his [[Currency/Legends|wealth]] to become the unofficial protector of the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]], in the process taking [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of the [[Proton torpedo/Legends|torpedo]] sphere.<ref name="Insider66" /> In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]],<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> however, Grand Admiral [[Josef Grunger]], who had amassed an [[Fleet/Legends|armada]] of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] including thirty [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class]] and [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyers]] and over one hundred [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]], planned to use the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] as a base to launch a strike at the Imperial [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Insider66" />

Forced to defend his holdings, Pitta put the torpedo sphere to ingenious use, decimating Grunger's fleet in a [[Battle of Tralus (Galactic Civil War)|battle]]<ref name="Insider66" /> at the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system's]] planet [[Tralus/Legends|Tralus]].<ref name="CSWE Tralus" /> Pridefully refusing to back down, however, Grunger rammed his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]],<ref name="Insider66" /> the nineteen-thousand-meter [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]]<ref name="EGTW" /> [[Aggressor (Executor-class)|''Aggressor'']], into the heart of Pitta's craft,<ref name="Insider66" /> leading to the ''Aggressor''{{'s}} destruction<ref name="EGTW" /> and the [[Death/Legends|death]] of both Grand Admirals.<ref name="Insider66" />

==Behind the scenes==
The torpedo sphere used by Grand Admiral Danetta Pitta was first mentioned in the article "[[Who's Who: Imperial Grand Admirals]]," which was authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Abel G. Peña]] and published in the [[Star Wars Insider 66|sixty-sixth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine<ref name="Insider66" /> on [[February 14]], [[2003]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/news/2003/02/news20030203.html|text=''Star Wars Insider'' #66}}</ref> That article was in turn a reworked version of an [[Dirty Dozen: The Imperial Grand Admirals|article]] on the Galactic Empire's Grand Admirals that Wallace and Peña had written for an issue of the ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine. The publication of the latter article was prevented by that magazine's eventual cancellation.<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|danwallace|16|Grand Admirals: What Have They Got in their Pocketsses?}}</ref> [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' subsequently introduced an official name for Grand Admiral Pitta's torpedo sphere.<ref name="CSWE Tralus" />
